source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chromosomal theory of inheritance (PDF 100).

blocks.text: 1900 mein German mahir-e-genetics (geneticist) Karl Correns ne Mendel ka kaam dobara dhoond nikala (rediscover kiya) aur kaha ke virasat (heredity) mein chromosomes ka kirdar hai. 1902 mein American scientist Walter Sutton ne virasat ka chromosomal theory (nazariya) pesh kiya. Yeh theory kehti hai:

items: Genes chromosomes par khaas jaghon (locations) par hote hain.
Meiosis mein chromosomes ka rawaiya (behaviour) Mendel ke virasat ke qawaneen ko samjhata hai.

blocks.caption: Mendel ke qawaneen aur meiosis mein chromosomes
header: Meiosis mein chromosomes kya karte hain
rows: Segregation: har khasiyat ke do alleles, har gamete mein aik
Do alleles wale homologous chromosomes meiosis I mein alag alag gametes mein jate hain.
Independent assortment: mukhtalif khasiyatein azad ho kar alag
Mukhtalif homologous jore ittefaqan qatar mein lagte hain, is liye mukhtalif chromosomes ke genes azad ho kar alag hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Virasat ka chromosomal theory kis ne aur kab pesh kiya?
blocks.explanation: Walter Sutton ne 1902 mein, jab Karl Correns 1900 mein Mendel ka kaam dobara dhoond chuke the.

items: Correns (1900): Mendel ka kaam dobara daryaft; Sutton (1902): chromosomal theory.
Genes chromosomes par khaas jaghon par hain; meiosis Mendel ke qawaneen ko samjhata hai.
